decision: User selected corrected versioned source and explicit legacy migration on 2026-09-09; no default cutover or canonical admission
body: Exactly description and typed_contract; legacy untyped bodies remain separate
trigger: A qualified Event selector is an input symbol, not a constructed occurrence, receipt or proof of delivery. Every canonical Event transitions State Machine edge matches a trigger; output intent does not create this edge.
guard: Null or a reference to a declared typed Rule with exact typed argument bindings from explicit inputs; never an inline predicate or caller-supplied Boolean
output_intents: Ordered distinct slots with qualified Event references; repeated Event references in distinct slots remain separate intents. No occurrence identity, payload, construction, publication or persistence is inferred.
determinism: Unique transition IDs and unique source-state/trigger pairs. No hidden priority between competing guards; invalid state/trigger symbols reject and declared but unavailable pairs return no-transition.
reducer: Pure synchronous function over a closed state union, trigger-symbol union and explicit typed facts. Validate inputs, select the state/trigger pair, then evaluate its Rule. Return a frozen transitioned result with target state and intents, or a frozen rejected result retaining the source state and no intents.
types: Reuse exact core scalar/named/optional/list/set/sum values and Rule v8 normalization; no database access or owned-Entity mutation
migration: Non-writing helper requires explicit trigger and guard-argument bindings for every legacy transition; preserves states, IDs, targets and output Event intent. Returns separate old-output and new-trigger relationship sets for reviewed graph migration. No guessed trigger or automatic file/edge changes.
compatibility: Old source, generation, frozen profile sources and defaults retain existing behavior. Legacy renderers reject the new schema with a configured-profile diagnostic.
verification: Source and compiled snapshot validation, explicit migration failures, native compilation and declarations, hostile inputs, trigger/output non-collapse, guard ordering, immutable rejection, deterministic replay and compiling semantic mutations
claim_ceiling: Candidate TypeScript reducer and source reconciliation only; not an Event transport, durable runtime, public CLI profile integration, three-language parity or full PCR completion
